02 TEAM RELAY

Typhoon Race

Five players. One pole. Run the course together and pass the relay to your next group.

Race walkthrough

01 / 04
AT THE START

BEFORE THE RACE

Typhoon Race rules

Set up

All three teams race at the same time, with one lane per team. Waiting teammates line up in rows of five. The front row goes next.

Pass the pole

When the group returns, two players sweep the pole low so the waiting players can jump over it. They sweep it back high so everyone can duck. Then the next group runs.

Keep going

If anyone drops or lets go of the pole, grab it again and continue. There’s no penalty if the pole touches a waiting teammate who misses the jump or duck.

Finish

Teams are ranked in the order they finish the relay.
